items.text: All 9 workshop decisions (5 from R1, 4 from R2) have been incorporated into plan.md Section 8 (Contract Decisions). The key non-obvious change was sidebar collapse behavior (R2 d3): user chose full hide (0px) over the recommended icon rail. Plan sections 6 (Target End State), 7 (Implementation Strategy Phase 2), 8 (Sidebar Contract), 9 (Testing Plan), 10 (Validation Checklist), 11 (Risks), and 13 (Definition of Done) were all updated to reflect full-hide behavior and a new risk row for filter inaccessibility when collapsed.

Four new contract decisions were formalized from R2: Test Strategy (store-first, no React Flow internal assertions), Keyboard Shortcut Scheme (1-3 lenses, L/I/Esc actions), Sidebar Collapse Behavior (full hide 0px both platforms), and Default Layout Mode (hierarchical for all lenses, per-lens persistence).

All five readiness dimensions score 3/3. Problem clarity and scope were already solid from R1. Approach is now fully settled with all architectural decisions locked. Testability reached 3 after the store-first testing strategy was confirmed — the testing plan now has a clear philosophy and concrete test file list. Risk awareness improved with the sidebar filter-inaccessibility risk added for the full-hide decision. No remaining gaps block execution.

plan_updates: Incorporated 4 decisions from workshop R2 into plan.md: (1) added Test Strategy, Keyboard Shortcut Scheme, Sidebar Collapse Behavior, and Default Layout Mode as formal contract decisions in Section 8; (2) rewrote Sidebar Contract from icon-rail (48px) to full-hide (0px) with floating toggle; (3) updated Target End State, Phase 2 implementation, Testing Plan, Validation Checklist, and Definition of Done to reflect full-hide sidebar and store-first testing; (4) added risk row for sidebar filter inaccessibility when collapsed.
